Then (t star t) star t^2=t^4+hbar t^3, whereas t star (t star t^2)=t^4, despite B1(1,f)=B1(f,1)=0. Restricting the equivalence to the unit requirement preserves the explicit associativity requirement and the complete approved formal-product interface.

The cited proposition states bracket closure but actually proves the stronger insertion closure in Proof step 5.1. In each insertion, a unit input either lies in the inner block and kills that normalized cochain, or remains in the outer cochain and kills it. Leibniz expansion of a finite composition of finite-order differential operators gives a finite multidifferential expression. Thus the Definition accurately says insertion closure is proved there; it does not claim it appears verbatim in the proposition Statement. No edit is needed.
